d <- read.csv('inputs/Swarm_2.csv', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
mi <- subset(d, StrainNumber == '287_98')

cat('"'n=', nrow(mi), ' range=', range(mi"'$x), '"'\\n', sep='')
mods <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ poly(x, 2, raw=TRUE), data=mi),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ poly(x, 3, raw=TRUE), data=mi),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ splines::ns(x, df=4), data=mi)
)
for (nm in names(mods)) {
  m <- mods[[nm]]
  cat('\\n', nm, '\\n', sep='')
  cat('AIC=', AIC(m), ' BIC=', BIC(m), ' R2=', summary(m)"'$r.squared, '"' adjR2=', summary(m)"'$adj.r.squared, '"' RMSE=', sqrt(mean(residuals(m)"'^2)), '"'\\n', sep='')
  print(coef(m))
}
# robust maximum by dense grid and local optimize around candidate grid maxima
predmax <- function(m, lo=0, hi=1) {
  g <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=1000001)
  p <- as.numeric(predict(m, newdata=data.frame(x=g)))
  i <- which.max(p)
  left <- if (i == 1) lo else g[i-1]
  right <- if (i == length(g)) hi else g[i+1]
  opt <- optimize(function(z) -as.numeric(predict(m, newdata=data.frame(x=z))), c(left, right), maximum=FALSE)
  # include endpoints
  candx <- c(lo, hi, opt"'$minimum)
  candp <- as.numeric(predict(m, newdata=data.frame(x=candx)))
  j <- which.max(candp)
  c(x=candx[j], pred=candp[j])
}

for (nm in names(mods)) print(c(model=nm, predmax(mods[[nm]], 0, 1)))
cat('\\nMAX over observed mixture range\\n')

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
d <- read.csv('inputs/Swarm_2.csv', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
d <- d[d"'$StrainNumber == '"'287_98', , drop=FALSE]
d"'$freq287 <- vapply(strsplit(d$Ratio, '"':', fixed=TRUE), function(z) {
  q <- as.numeric(z)
  q[1] / sum(q)
}, numeric(1))
models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ poly(freq287, 2, raw=TRUE), data=d),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ poly(freq287, 3, raw=TRUE), data=d),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ splines::ns(freq287, df=4), data=d)
)
fit_table <- data.frame(
  model=names(models),
  AIC=vapply(models, AIC, numeric(1)),
  BIC=vapply(models, BIC, numeric(1)),
  adj_R2=vapply(models, function(m) summary(m)"'$adj.r.squared, numeric(1))
)
print(fit_table, row.names=FALSE)
best <- models[[which.min(fit_table$AIC)]]
objective <- function(x) -as.numeric(predict(best, newdata=data.frame(freq287=x)))
opt <- optimize(objective, interval=range(d$freq287), tol=.Machine$double.eps''^0.25)
endpoints <- range(d$freq287)
vals <- c(-opt$objective, -objective(endpoints))
ans <- max(vals)
cat(sprintf('"'best=%s\\noptimal_freq=%.15f\\nmax_predicted_area=%.15f\\n', fit_table"'$model[which.min(fit_table$AIC)], opt$minimum, ans))
RS'

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
d <- read.csv('inputs/Swarm_2.csv', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
d <- d[d"'$StrainNumber == '"'287_98', , drop=FALSE]
d"'$freq287 <- vapply(strsplit(d$Ratio, '"':', fixed=TRUE), function(z) {q <- as.numeric(z); q[1]/sum(q)}, numeric(1))
m <- lm(Area ~ splines::ns(freq287, df=4), data=d)
f <- function(x) as.numeric(predict(m, newdata=data.frame(freq287=x)))
for (tol in c(1e-4,1e-8,1e-12,1e-14,1e-16)) {
  o <- optimize(function(z) -f(z), c(.89,.92), tol=tol)
  cat('tol',tol,'x',format(o"'$minimum, digits=17),'"'y',format(-o"'$objective,digits=17),'"'\\n')
}
# finite derivative and uniroot in local interval
h <- 1e-5
der <- function(x) (f(x+h)-f(x-h))/(2*h)
for (x in c(.9018,.9019,.90192,.90193,.9020)) cat('der',x,der(x),'\\n')
rt <- uniroot(der,c(.901,.903),tol=1e-12)"'$root
cat('"'root',format(rt,digits=17),'y',format(f(rt),digits=17),'der',der(rt),'\\n')
# spline knots
print(attr(splines::ns(d"'$freq287, df=4), '"'knots'))
RS"
